## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹² (prior scale)

Why: feasibility of a Landau fan at this rig's T_e before spending hours on one, plus a first look at the tone content. Run 6: B 0 → 10 T at (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166); run 7: B 10 → 0.3 T at (−0.277, −0.465); both 10 nA, sr1 50 µV, T 1.17–1.29 K, no leakage (|I_gate| ≤ 0.22 nA). Raw traces first, then FFT in 1/B, then the Rxx-minima filling ladder.

"""Runs 6-7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw Rxx(B) first, then FFT in 1/B and the Rxx-minima filling ladder."""
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset

spots = [(6, +3.2), (7, -1.2)]          # (run, n in 1e12 cm^-2 on the geometry-prior scale)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
ladder = {}
for k, (rid, n12) in enumerate(spots):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I); o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12 (prior scale), F_L(prior) = {FL:.1f} T; R {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.1f} Ohm; "
          f"I {I.min()*1e9:.2f}-{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA; |I_tg|max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA, "
          f"|I_bg|max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA; T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K")
    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[k, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[k, 0].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[k, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9); print(on.summary())
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.0, 10.0), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5); sp = sp[0]
    ax[k, 1].plot(f, sp / sp[f > 2].max()); ax[k, 1].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_L prior {FL:.1f} T")
    ax[k, 1].set_xlim(0, 60); ax[k, 1].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[k, 1].set_title(f"FFT in 1/B, B [1, 10] T (dF 1.1 T)"); ax[k, 1].legend()
    pk, _ = find_peaks(-gaussian_filter1d(R, 2), prominence=8, distance=5); pk = pk[B[pk] > 0.8]
    nuB = abs(n12) * 1e16 * cst.h / cst.e
    ladder[rid] = (B[pk], nuB / B[pk], R[pk])
# filling ladder of run-6 minima: find the density-scale s that puts nu = s * nu_prior on multiples of 4
Bm, nup, Rm = ladder[6]
ss = np.arange(0.80, 1.05, 0.001); cost = [np.sqrt(np.mean((s * nup / 4 - np.round(s * nup / 4)) ** 2)) for s in ss]
s_best = ss[int(np.argmin(cost))]; nu_true = s_best * nup
print(f"\nrun 6 minima ladder: best density scale s = {s_best:.3f} (rms {min(cost)*4:.2f} in nu) -> F_L(true) = {s_best*33.1:.1f} T")
print("  B (T):  " + "  ".join(f"{b:5.2f}" for b in Bm)); print("  nu:     " + "  ".join(f"{v:5.1f}" for v in nu_true))
present = sorted(set(int(4 * round(v / 4)) for v in nu_true)); print(f"  4k minima present: {present}; missing in 16-80: {[v for v in range(16, 84, 4) if v not in present]}")
ax[0, 2].plot(nu_true, Rm, "o"); [ax[0, 2].axvline(v, color="0.85", lw=0.8) for v in range(4, 92, 4)]
ax[0, 2].set_xlabel(f"nu = {s_best:.3f} x nu_prior"); ax[0, 2].set_ylabel("R at minimum (Ohm)"); ax[0, 2].set_title("run 6 Rxx minima vs filling (grid: nu = 4k)")
ax[1, 2].plot(ss, np.array(cost) * 4); ax[1, 2].axvline(s_best, color="r", ls="--"); ax[1, 2].set_xlabel("density scale s"); ax[1, 2].set_ylabel("rms off 4k (nu)")
ax[1, 2].set_title("ladder fit — run 6")
fig.suptitle("vti-02 SdH spot checks, runs 6 (e) / 7 (h), D = 0, T = 1.17-1.29 K, 10 nA"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6–7):** Fan is feasible at this T_e. Run 6 goes quantum-Hall by 1.8 T (R_xx minima ≈ 0 Ω from 1.8 to 7.2 T), with SdH from ~0.3 T.

- **Density scale:** the run-6 minima fall on a **ν = 4k ladder** once the geometry-prior density is scaled by **s = 0.894** (rms 0.31 in ν). So the true n ≈ 0.89 × prior (c_tg prior ~12 % high), and **F_L(true) ≈ 29.6 T** at this spot. This is a single-spot, ladder-based scale; the fan's ν-lines will fix it properly.
- **Missing ladder members:** ν = 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 44, 48, 60, 64, 80 are present. **40, 52, 56, 68–76 are missing**, a gap roughly every ~16 in ν. That is what LL coincidences between two subbands look like. A single 4-fold band (ABCA) would give every 4k.
- **Tones:** 7.1 / 22.2 / 29.5 T (`sdh_onset`, SNR 41 / 101 / 88). **7.1 + 22.2 = 29.3 ≈ 29.5 = F_L(true)**: a light pocket carrying 0.24 of the density, a heavy one carrying 0.75, and the total-density oscillation. `sdh_onset` flags 22.2 / 29.5 as ≈ 3× / 4× of 7.1. With one spot I can't fully rule out harmonics, but a lone 7.1 T fundamental would need an ~17-fold degeneracy at this n, which is unphysical.
- **Lean (one spot, not yet a call):** two subbands at n_e ≈ 2.9×10¹² with light fraction ≈ 0.24. That is ABAB-like (bilayer-pair model: ≈ 0.25–0.3, weakly n-dependent). It is against ABCA (single F_L pocket at this n). ABCB (chiral 3+1 decomposition) predicts a Dirac-like light band whose fraction is small at low n and grows with n. That n-dependence is what the fan must test.
- **Hole side (run 7, n_h ≈ 1.1×10¹² true):** multi-tone (4.7 / 6.6 / 8.5 / 12.3 T, onset 0.7 T). The minima don't sit on a clean 4k ladder. This is the near-CNP regime where ABAB's band overlap gives several pockets; I don't take a read from it alone.
- **Confound carried forward:** the series region B (ridge B, run 5, offset 0.43×10¹² prior) may add tones at ≈ ×1.13 on the electron side.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² × B 1 → 10 T

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.25e12 (prior) 151 pts fast along D=0 (Vtg,Vbg co-swept) x B 1->10 T 82 rows uniform 1/B slow; fast\_delay 1 s; sr1 100 uV; Vsi 0; T base; ends 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~11:11** (≈5h45m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`); the operator asked for the fan. The spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show QH by 1.8 T and a two-band signature at n_e = +3.2×10¹²: tones 7.1 / 22.2 / 29.5 T with 7.1 + 22.2 ≈ 29.5 = F_L. The minima form a ν = 4k ladder only after scaling the density prior by ×0.894, and ν = 40, 52, 56, 68–76 are missing. That leans ABAB, but it is one point. The fan decides:
- **(a)** absolute n scale from the ν-line slopes
- **(b)** per-n tone count, the sum rule, and the **light-tone fraction vs n**: ABAB ≈ 0.25–0.3 and flat; ABCB's Dirac band starts small and grows with n; ABCA has none
- **(c)** the missing-minima / LL-crossing pattern
- **(d)** the hole side and CNP

**Design:**
- **Fast axis:** n along the run-5 D = 0 line, co-sweeping V_tg / V_bg, −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² (prior scale), 151 pts at 0.03×10¹².
- **Slow axis:** B, 82 rows **uniform in 1/B** from 1 to 10 T. Δ(1/B) = 0.0111 gives Nyquist 45 T (≥ 1.5 × F_L(true) ≈ 30 T, room for region-B tones at ×1.13) and ΔF = 1.1 T.
- **Settling:** fast_delay 1 s = 3.3 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB. This is a uniform ~1-point lag in the sweep direction, harmless for per-column 1/B FFTs, and gives timing parity with run 5. slow_delay 3 s after each flyback + field step.
- **Sensitivity:** sr1 fixed at 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS. A rail at the high-B ν = 0 core near n = 0 is accepted.
- **Protection and end state:** leak guard at 1 nA. Gates park at 0 at the end; the field stays at 10 T for step 5 to ride down.

**Coverage trade:** the n window is TG-limited at both ends (the D = 0 line leaves [−0.3, +1.0] V at −1.27 / +3.27). The hole side reaches only ≈ −1.1×10¹² true. There is no finite-D coverage here (that is step 5). Starting at 0.7 T instead of 1 T would sharpen ΔF to 0.75 T for about +2 h (39 more rows); not bought, since the light tone is already resolved at 1.1 T.

**Price:** from run 5 (1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1 s) + 0.03 s for the second gate set, 151 pts × 1.13 s + ~10 s turnaround ≈ 180 s/row. 82 rows = 4 h 06 m, plus the field ramps 1 → 10 T at 0.137 T/min (66 m) and the pre-ramp 0 → 1 T (7 m) = 5 h 19 m, quoted with ~8 % overrun.

**Checkpoints:**
- **First rows (≈ 10 min in):** R scale at B ≈ 1 T vs run 6 (≈ 15–20 Ω at +3.2) and near the CNP; rail; I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA; gate currents.
- **Row ~25 (B ≈ 1.4 T, ~1 h 30 m) and row ~50 (B ≈ 2.2 T, ~3 h):** interim per-column FFT on the landed rows, with the light-tone fraction vs n.
- **Row ~70 (B ≈ 4.5 T):** the ν-line scale fit.

Abandon if the channel rails away from the CNP, the leak guard trips, or no oscillations appear by row 50.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 1 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B (82 rows) x n fast along D = 0, -1.25 -> +3.25e12 (151 pts) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (ratio data-calibrated; absolute n scale = geometry prior, ~0.89x true per run-6 ladder) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.25, 3.25 + 1e-9, 0.03), 4)          # 1e12 cm^-2 (prior scale), 151 pts
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.asarray(Vtg_vec, float), np.asarray(Vbg_vec, float)
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_rt, _D_rt = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(_D_rt).max() < 1e-6 and np.abs(_n_rt - n_vec).max() < 1e-6
B_vec = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 82)                                  # ascending, d(1/B) = 0.0111 -> Nyquist 45 T, dF 1.1 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts), Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, uniform 1/B)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_sr, _vrg = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {_sr}/{_vrg} (0/0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, V_tg/V_bg = {k_tg.volt():+.3f}/{k_bg.volt():+.3f}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at 0: {_B0} T"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert _sr == 0 and _vrg == 0, "a heater range is on"
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
# Fixed sensitivity, no autorange mid-map: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. SdH/QH away from the CNP is 0-600 Ohm (runs 6-7);
# a rail at the high-B nu = 0 core near n = 0 is accepted (not the discriminator), flagged at the checkpoint.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz -> {sr1.amplitude()/100e6*1e9:.1f} nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V; "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0: B 1->10 T uniform 1/B (82 rows) slow; n -1.25..+3.25e12 prior (151, 0.03e12) along D=0 fast "
                  "(Vtg,Vbg co-swept); run-5 cal; Vsi 0; sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; '
              f'n on geometry-prior scale, run-6 ladder says true = 0.894 x prior); fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12, {len(n_vec)} pts; '
              f'slow B {B_vec[0]:.2f}..{B_vec[-1]:.2f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows uniform in 1/B; Vsi = 0; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s')

# --- move to the start: gates to the first fan point, then the field 0 -> 1 T (unrecorded, ~7.3 min at 0.137 T/min) ---
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
print(f"ramping field {magnet.field():+.3f} -> {B_vec[0]:.3f} T ..."); magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
print(f"at start: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # gates park at 0; the field stays where the fan left it (10 T on completion) — the next step rides it down.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T.               f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')

s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
